preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if (N := int(line.split()[0])) is not None)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive, representing the number of friends.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(0 <= a < i for i, a in enumerate(map(int, line.split()[1:]), 1)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if (N := int(line.split()[0])) is not None and (A := map(int, line.split()[1:])) is not None)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A is a list of N integers where A[i] (1-based) satisfies 0 ≤ A[i] < i, representing the friend each person wants to stand next to.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == str(min_steps) for i, (N, A) in enumerate(zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [map(int, line.split()[1:]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])) if (min_steps := compute_min_steps(N, list(A))) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the minimal number of steps required to seat all friends according to the rules. The function `compute_min_steps(N, A)` computes the minimal steps by simulating the seating process, where each new person i inserts to the right of A[i] (or leftmost if A[i] = 0), and the cost is the minimum of shifting all left or all right of the insertion point.
